# LTX-2.5

LTX-2.5 is Lightricks' open video generation model : fast, local-first, and built for production. Run it locally, fine-tune it for your own use case, or integrate it into your pipeline.

**Key highlights:**

- **Pixel Diffusion** : keyframes-first generation that builds every scene on a grid of high-fidelity keyframes for industry-leading pixel quality
- **Diffusion Video Decoder** : sharper faces, legible text, fewer smears in fast motion
- **Native multishot** : one generation yields multiple connected shots holding character, environment, lighting, voice, and style across cuts
- **Custom Gemma 4 12B text encoder** : retains multiple subjects, actions, lighting, detail, and camera direction across complex prompts
- **Dedicated Prompt Enhancer** : a lightweight model that expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions at near-zero extra compute
- **Auto Duration** : predicts the right clip length from the described action before diffusion begins
- **Better distilled model** : carries far more quality, prompt adherence, and motion into a smaller, faster variant
- Carried over from LTX-2.3: native 4K, synchronized audio-video

Official model & files: https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5
## What this workflow does

This **Text-to-Video** workflow generates a video directly from a text prompt. Write your prompt, optionally enable the Prompt Enhancer, and the model renders a clip with cinematic pixel quality and synchronized audio.

## Subgraph parameters

The **Text to Video (LTX-2.5)** node is a subgraph. Click the **Enter subgraph** button at the bottom of the node to open its internal graph, where you can inspect and fine-tune every step of the pipeline (conditioning, sampler, CFG guider, VAE decode, and more).

| Parameter | What it does |
|---|---|
| prompt | Text prompt describing the scene, action, lighting, camera, and style |
| prompt_enhance | Toggle the built-in Prompt Enhancer: expands short prompts into rich cinematic instructions at near-zero extra compute |
| duration | Clip length in seconds (Auto Duration can predict it from the action) |
| width / height | Output resolution in pixels (e.g. 1280×720) |
| seed | Random seed : set a fixed value to reproduce the same result |
| frame_rate | Frames per second |
| unet_name | Main model: LTX-2.5 distilled transformer (ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| video_vae | Video VAE used for decoding (ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| audio_vae | Audio VAE that produces synchronized audio (ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors) |
| clip_name | Text encoder: custom Gemma 4 12B with projection (gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors) |
| upscale_model | Latent upscaler applied before decoding for higher-fidelity output |
| prompt_enhance_model | Model checkpoint used by the Prompt Enhancer |

## How to use

1. Download the models listed in **Note: Model Links** and place them in ComfyUI's `models/` folder
2. Write your prompt, optionally toggle **prompt_enhance** for short prompts
3. Set **duration** / **width** / **height** / **frame_rate** (defaults work well) and hit **Queue**
4. To dive deeper, click **Enter subgraph** at the bottom of the main node : every internal step (conditioning, sampler, CFG, VAE decode) can be edited there

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   ├── gemma4_e2b_it_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── ltx-2.5-video-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 latent_upscale_models/
│       └── ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors
```

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

[PROMPT TYPE]
MiniMax H3 text-to-video. No reference images. Single continuous 10-second shot, cinematic wuxia live-action realism.

[CHARACTERS]
古装女子: late-20s Chinese woman in a flowing white hanfu robe with wide sleeves and an emerald silk sash, long black hair partly tied up with a silver hairpin, wielding a slender straight sword (jian). Her face is original and realistic, calm and focused.
古装男子: mid-30s Chinese man in a dark-grey warrior robe with leather shoulder guards, hair tied back with a dark headband, a short beard, wielding a single broadsword (dao). His face is original and realistic, fierce and controlled.
The two are clearly distinct people; neither resembles any celebrity or stylized character.

[SCENE]
An ancient Chinese town street at dusk: stone-paved road lined with wooden shop houses, hanging paper lanterns, cloth banners fluttering, and a distant pagoda silhouette. The street is empty except for the two fighters; a few market stalls sit overturned near the edges. Thin evening mist drifts low over the stones.

[SHOT TIMELINE]
0.0–2.5 seconds — Wide establishing framing: the two face each other from opposite ends of the street, blades drawn, lanterns swaying; they burst forward at the same time, robes and sashes streaming.
2.5–6.0 seconds — They clash at the center: sword and broadsword ring together in rapid exchanges, sparks glinting, sleeves and hair flying with each move; the woman spins low and slashes upward, the man blocks and counters with a heavy sweep.
6.0–8.5 seconds — The woman leaps lightly off a stall edge and strikes from above; the man steps back and parries, sending her landing a few paces away; dust and scattered petals kick up from the stone.
8.5–10.0 seconds — Both settle into guarded stances several meters apart, chests heaving, blades still raised, lantern light flickering between them; hold on this tense standoff.

[CAMERA]
16:9 cinematic framing. Smooth tracking and subtle handheld energy that follows the fighters, with one slow orbit during the clash; no whip pans, no disorienting cuts, no zoom pumping. Keep both fighters readable in frame throughout.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
Dusk amber lantern light mixed with cool blue evening sky; strong rim light on flowing robes and hair during movement. Clean transparent image, filmic highlight rolloff, Arri Alexa-like color science, low-medium saturation, fine subtle film grain. Live-action realistic wuxia drama look — not anime, not 3D, not CG.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
Clear metallic sword-clash rings, whooshing fabric and blade cuts through air, quick footwork on stone, low tense breathing; a thin evening wind and distant wooden creak as ambience. No music, no dialogue, no voice-over.

[CONTINUITY]
Both characters keep the same face, hairstyle, costume and weapon for the whole shot; the street layout and lantern positions stay consistent; the woman's white robe and the man's grey robe never swap or change color.

[NEGATIVES]
No identity resembling any pre-existing celebrity or stylized character, no extra main fighters, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no narration, no background music, no song, no anime / 3D / CG look, no teleporting or floaty weightless motion, no limbs passing through bodies, no duplicated swords, no deformed hands or faces, no flickering costumes, no oversaturation, no watermark, no logo, no gore.
